login.title: Log in
login.description: Admin access for the Depad team.
login.expired: Your session expired, please log in again.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: The shared library of product properties: size, color, thickness…
attributes.dialogHint: Fill Romanian first; Russian can follow later.
attributes.name: Name
attributes.optionCodeLocked: Saved options keep their code; products refer to it.
attributes.deleteHint: Attributes used by a product type cannot be deleted.

types.title: Product types
types.description: A type decides which attributes its products have and which ones create variants.
types.name: Name
types.attributesHint: Required: must be filled before publishing. Variant: each option becomes a separate variant (only for one-option attributes).
types.axisOnlyOption: Only one-option attributes can create variants.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: The storefront menu. Inactive categories are hidden from customers.
categories.name: Name

products.title: Products
products.description: Everything in the shop. Drafts are invisible to customers until published.
products.noTypes: There are no product types yet.
products.typeHint: The type decides the fields and variants. It cannot be changed later.
products.name: Name
products.typeMissing: This product type does not exist anymore.
products.attributesHint: Fields from the product type; * is required to publish. Add more from the library if this product needs them.
products.noAttributes: This type has no fields besides the variants.
products.addAttributeHint: Pick one from the library, or create a new one — it is then available for all products.
products.customHint: Only for this product, e.g. “Collaboration: Limited edition”. Shown on the product page, not used as a filter.
products.variantsHint: One row per {axes} the customer can choose. Each has its own SKU, price and stock.
products.noVariants: No variants yet — add them below.
products.singleVariantHint: This type has no variant attributes, so the product has exactly one variant.
products.photosHint: The first photo is the main one. Drag to reorder; changes to photos are saved immediately.
products.photosAfterSave: Save the product first, then add photos.
products.leaveConfirm: Leave without saving? Your changes will be lost.
products.archiveHint: Customers will not see it anymore. Orders and stock history stay. You can restore it as a draft later.
products.deleteHint: It is removed for good. Published products are archived instead.

media.title: Media
media.description: All uploaded images. Drop files anywhere on this page to upload. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
media.uploadFailedHint: The file could not be uploaded.
media.empty: No images yet. Drop files here or click Upload.
media.deleteHint: The image and its address are removed for good.
media.deleteUsedHint: This image is in use, so the server will refuse; remove it from those products first.

crop.cropHint: Drag the frame to move it, drag a corner to resize. Only this use of the image changes.
crop.focalHint: Click the most important spot (e.g. the logo). Narrow screens keep it visible.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Start with “To handle”: confirm, pack and ship. Everything else is history.
orders.refundNeededCount: {count, plural, one {# refund needed} other {# refunds needed}}
orders.search: Search number, phone, name or email

nextStep.New: New order — check it (call the customer if needed) and confirm.
nextStep.Confirmed: Confirmed — pack it from a house.
nextStep.Packed: Packed — hand it to Nova Post and enter the waybill.
nextStep.Shipped: On the way — mark delivered, or returned if it was not picked up.
nextStep.Delivered: Delivered. If the customer sends something back, create a return.
nextStep.ReturnedToSender: Returned to sender — the parcel came back.

orders.name: Name
orders.internalNoteHint: Only the team sees this, e.g. “deliver after 18:00”

dialogs.packHint: The items are taken from this house's stock.
dialogs.shipHint: Enter the Nova Post waybill number.
dialogs.unpackHint: The items go back to the house and are reserved for this order again.
dialogs.deliverCodHint: Cash on delivery: the order is marked paid ({total}).
dialogs.returnToSenderHint: The customer did not pick it up. Choose the house the items go back to.
dialogs.cancelPackedHint: The packed items go back to their house.
dialogs.cancelPaidHint: It was paid: after cancelling it is marked “Refund needed”.
dialogs.linkHint: Creates a new link to the order page for the customer. The old link stops working.

slip.hint: Packing slip — use your browser's Print.
slip.thanks: Thank you for shopping at Depad!

discounts.title: Discounts
discounts.description: One offer per order: the customer sees every offer that saves money, the best is preselected, nothing combines.
discounts.newHint: Percent off, or buy X get Y free — automatic or with a code.
discounts.usedTimes: {count, plural, =0 {Not used in any order yet.} one {Used in # order.} other {Used in # orders.}}
discounts.name: Name
discounts.nameHint: Customers see this name next to the price.
discounts.buyXGetYHint: For every full group (e.g. 2 + 1 = 3 items) the cheapest ones are free.
discounts.perCustomerHint: Counted by phone number. Empty = no limit.
discounts.targetsHint: Everything, or specific categories (including their subcategories), types, brands, products or variants.
discounts.leaveConfirm: Leave without saving? Your changes will be lost.
discounts.deleteHint: Only discounts never used in an order can be deleted; switch used ones off instead.

tryCart.title: Try a cart
tryCart.description: Put products in a test cart to see exactly which offers a customer would get. Nothing is ordered.
tryCart.add: Add a product: type SKU or name
tryCart.noOffers: No offers for this cart — regular price {total}.

codeStatus.NotActive: Code {code} is not active (off, not started or ended).
codeStatus.NotApplicable: Code {code} does not apply to anything in this cart.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Shop-wide numbers, and how customers pay and receive their orders.
settings.lowStockAtHint: A variant is “low” when this many or fewer are available (dashboard and Stock filter).
settings.vatRateHint: Used for products that have no VAT of their own. Prices already include VAT.
settings.paymentsHint: Only switched-on methods are offered at checkout, in this order.
settings.deliveriesHint: Fee, and the order total from which delivery is free.

returns.title: Returns
returns.description: Items customers send back after delivery. Money is refunded by hand and then marked here.
returns.newHint: Enter how many of each item the customer sends back and why.
returns.lineInfo: {left} of {bought} can still be returned · paid {paid} each
returns.receiveHint: For each item choose its condition and where it goes. Resellable items go to a house that sells; damaged ones to a B-grade place.
returns.refundHint: Refund the customer by hand first (e.g. bank transfer). The items were paid {paid}; change the amount if you refunded a different sum.
returns.cancelHint: Its items can be returned again later.

inventory.addVariant: Add a product: type SKU or name
inventory.noLines: No lines yet — search above to add products.
inventory.noDifferences: No differences — the count matched the stock.
inventory.noLocations: There are no active locations yet; stock needs a place.
inventory.leaveConfirm: Leave without saving? The document is not recorded yet.

new.receiptHint: Goods arrived from a supplier. The cost per unit is used for profit reports.
new.adjustmentHint: Write off damaged, lost or gifted items, or add found ones.
new.countHint: Enter what you physically counted. Only differences are recorded; products you do not list stay as they are.
new.transferHint: Move items from one location to another; the total stays the same.

stock.title: Stock
stock.description: What is where. Reserved = in open orders; available = sellable minus reserved.

documents.title: Stock documents
documents.description: Every stock change is a numbered document. Nothing is edited in place.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Places that hold stock, e.g. the two houses. Sellable locations count towards what customers can buy.
locations.name: Name
locations.sellableHint: Off for places like the B-grade shelf: stock is kept but not offered to customers.

errors.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

admin.notSaved: Not saved: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}}
